title: My Son Sold My $740K Business, Then Gave Me A $3,800 Ring Box. So I Claimed The Company.
description: After my son sold my $740K ring business and offered me a $3,800 ring box as thanks, I exposed his forgery using our original notarized partnership hidden in a wax carving block. Now I own ‘Ring of Perjury Heirlooms’, he wears a vest reading ‘Forged in Deceit’, and every ring box prints his criminal case number. #FamilyBetrayal #RingOfPerjury #JusticeServed
thumb_text: HE STOLE MY BUSINESS. NOW HE POLISHES MY RINGS.
pinned_comment: If your son sold your $740K ring business and handed you a $3,800 ring box as thanks, how would you respond? I took the company and now he wears a vest that says ‘Forged in Deceit’. Would you have done the same? Share your story in the comments.
